paragraphs: Abba bar Machsya, father of Rabbi Yitzchak: [Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Megillah.2.2.6). Rava bar Machsya: [Shabbat 10b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.10b.3-4); in [Taanit 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.12b.8) the reading is Rabbah. Hyman suggests that he may be Abba, noting that Rabbah and Rava bore the name Abba.[^1]

notes.text: The Yerushalmi names Rabbi Yitzchak bar Abba bar Machsya, as does [Heilprin’s Abba notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=87&lang=en). Shabbat has Rava and Taanit has Rabbah, each transmitting from Rav Chama bar Gurya in the name of Rav. [Heilprin’s Rava entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3104&lang=en) records the difference, and [his Rabbah notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3197&lang=en) refers to it. Hyman’s connection with Abba is a suggestion.
